caregivers.description: Review license and certificate documents. Only approved caregivers appear to customers.
caregivers.emptyPendingText: New caregiver registrations will appear here for review.

toast.approved: {name} approved and now visible in search

tier.overrideHint: Choose “Auto” to let the system compute it from performance.
tier.overridePending: Manual tier override becomes available once the backend endpoint ships.

drawer.verifyHint: Verify the license against the {body, select, OTHER {relevant professional body's} other {{body}}} register before approving.

approve.title: Approve {name}?
approve.description: The profile goes live in customer search. Re-verification is scheduled for one year from today.
approve.label: Verification notes
approve.placeholder: e.g. PNC registry record validated and active.
approve.checked: I have checked license {license} against the {body} register.

reject.title: Reject {name}?
reject.description: The caregiver is told their documents failed verification.
reject.placeholder: e.g. License number not found on the PNC register.

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.description: The profile is hidden from search until reactivated. Use this for policy violations or unresolved safety complaints.
suspend.placeholder: e.g. Pending investigation of safety incident #inc-0004.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}'s account?
deactivate.description: Blocks the caregiver from signing in. This is stronger than suspension.

reverify.title: Request re-verification
reverify.description: The caregiver returns to Pending and is hidden from search until their credentials are approved again.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {name}?
reactivate.description: Restores the caregiver's account so they can sign in and appear in search again.
reactivate.suspendedNote: This caregiver is suspended. The API's reactivate action doesn't lift a suspension yet, so this also re-approves their credentials and restarts the re-verification date at 365 days.

documents.none: No documents uploaded. The caregiver can't be approved until a license or certificate is provided.

reverification.title: Re-verification
reverification.description: Approved caregivers must have their credentials re-checked periodically (annually by default).
reverification.noDueDate: {count, plural, one {# approved caregiver has} other {# approved caregivers have}} no re-verification date yet and {count, plural, one {isn't} other {aren't}} listed here.
reverification.truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} approved caregivers.
